message:
Now I understand the setup. The build.sh runs commands in a remote build environment, and submit.sh submits the PoC and trace for validation. Let me first build the fuzzer in the build environment to test my PoC locally. Let me check what's in `/gt/_work/src`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'ls -la /gt/_work/src/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls /gt/_work/src/* 2>/dev/null | head -30'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
